text:
maya: FYI canary rollout for inference-runtime chart v2.5.0 just failed when Argo applied the new CRD, GitOps sync blocked :grimacing:
alex: ugh, what error?
maya: kubectl apply errored with schema validation. snippet: ```Error from server (Invalid): customresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.k8s.io "inferenceconfigs.redwood.ai" is invalid: spec.versions[0].schema.openAPIV3Schema.properties.spec.properties.batchPolicy: Forbidden: type mismatch - was "string" now "object"```
jamal: that sounds like we shipped a breaking CRD change without conversionWebhook/strategy. Wasn't the intent to keep CRD backward compatible for 2.x? :thinking_face:
maya: right — the chart bump included a schema tweak to batchPolicy to allow object config (for dynamic batching). I didn't realize Argo would reject the apply during canary.
alex: ops-bot, did the GitOps repo show a failed sync?
ops-bot: GitOps sync failed: repo "infra/apps" -> apps/inference-runtime: sync blocked by resource validation error (inferenceconfigs.redwood.ai). Paused auto-rollout.
sophie: Is there a quick rollback for the chart? We can revert the HelmRelease in the repo but CRD apply already partly mutated cluster state?
jamal: If the CRD didn't successfully apply, reverting the HelmRelease should let the previously deployed controllers continue. But if the new controller pods started, they could try to reconcile against the incompatible spec. Need to check controllers.
maya: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep controller` shows two pods for v2.5 in CrashLoopBackOff (image: redwood/inference-controller:v2.5.0). Logs show admission webhook failure applying conversion webhook config: `webhook configuration contains certs signed by unknown CA`
alex: oh no — certs. Did the Helm chart assume the cert-manager webhook is already present? In some clusters we rely on cert-manager, in others we use pre-signed webhooks via KMS. This could be an environment drift between clusters.
sophie: This is exactly the kind of env drift our preflight terraform checks are supposed to catch. Which clusters hit it? Canary was in eu-west1-gpu-prod.
maya: only eu-west1 had the issue; us-central canary succeeded earlier today.
jamal: Plan: 1) Pause GitOps (done by ops-bot) 2) Roll back HelmRelease in repo for eu-west1 to previous chart 2.4.1 3) Patch controllers to stop reconciling (scale to 0) 4) Fix certs/conversion webhook in infra repo and run terraform apply in the cluster staging account.
alex: +1. Also add a guard in our release pipeline: if CRD schema changes are present, require a conversion webhook or increment CRD version and include a migration job in the chart. Don't allow split assumptions across clusters.
sophie: I'll open a quick RFC and link the PR for blocking check. We should also add a GitOps pre-sync script to validate CRD compatibility using `kubectl convert --raw` or kube-apiserver dry-run check.
maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/apps/merge_requests/412 — includes rollback, a canary-label exclusion for eu-west1, and a hotfix to set controller replicas to 0.
ops-bot: Rollout paused for inference-runtime (eu-west1). Incident channel notified.
jamal: For long-term: add a QA job to run the Helm chart in a mirror cluster with stricter webhook modes enabled. Also add a terraform detector for cert-manager vs managed-webhook config drift.
alex: One more: cost note — the canary allocates a small GPU pool while deploying; with rollbacks we've eaten ~3 GPU-hours in eu-west1. Flagging finance so they can ignore spikes but also we should add an automatic budget alarm for canary noise.
sophie: will track in infra backlog and add postmortem after this is stable. For now, approving the rollback PR so Argo can reconcile to known-good state.
maya: thanks team — I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks, good catch Maya.
sophie: ping me if you need help with the certs, I can pair on the terraform bits.
jamal: once rollback is applied, I'll verify there are no orphaned CRs and run our migration checker.
ops-bot: Rollback PR merged. Argo resumed sync at 2025-11-03T16:10:00Z.
maya: cluster eu-west1 now back to green, controllers stable at v2.4.1. Closing thread after postmortem.
